app.name: EuroDraft
app.description: Pick players from historical continental tournament squads and compete in a full simulated tournament.

landing.hero_subline: Choose your tactical formation, spin historical nations across 64 years of European tournament history, and build the ultimate XI to conquer the tournament.
landing.roulette_description: Each draft round, the tournament wheel spins a random historical nation and year. Pick one player from that squad to lock into your tactical formation!
landing.eras_description: Every tournament generation brings unique legends, iconic tactical styles, and authentic player ratings.
landing.era_1_subtitle: From Yashin's penalty saves to Panenka's daring chip that created football history.
landing.era_2_subtitle: Platini's magical 9-goal masterpiece, Van Basten's volley, and Denmark's fairytale.
landing.era_3_subtitle: Zidane, Figo, and the golden goal drama before Greece shocked the world in 2004 — then Spain's golden generation began their winning streak.
landing.era_4_subtitle: Portugal's shock 2016 triumph, Italy's 2021 revival, and Yamal's historic 2024 arrival.
landing.footer_cta_description: Choose your formation, conquer the draft roulette, and test your dream team in a simulated continental tournament.

legal.title: Legal Notice, Privacy & Terms
legal.subtitle: Official operator information, GDPR privacy declaration, simulation terms of service, and direct contact channel.
legal.disclaimer_text_1: EuroDraft is an independent non-commercial historical simulation game and fan project. All references to years, country names, flags, and historical tournament records are used solely for descriptive historical and educational purposes.
legal.disclaimer_text_2: This project is not affiliated with, sponsored by, endorsed by, or licensed by UEFA, FIFA, EA Sports, or any national football federations.
legal.liability_content_title: Limitation of Liability for Content & Links
legal.liability_content_text: As a service provider, we are responsible for our own content on these pages under general law. We assume no liability for the continuous availability or accuracy of external third-party links.
legal.privacy_controller_text: Responsible for data processing on this website under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR):
legal.privacy_localstorage_text: EuroDraft processes gameplay, formation selections, audio preferences, and draft states locally on your device using browser LocalStorage. No tracking cookies, advertising identifiers, or user surveillance mechanisms are employed.
legal.privacy_sharing_text: When you choose to share your tournament result, squad data and an optional nickname are stored on our server strictly with your explicit consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). You can request deletion of shared runs at any time by contacting us.
legal.privacy_serverlogs_text: Our hosting infrastructure automatically processes technical connection data (IP address, user agent, timestamp) strictly on the basis of legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) to ensure server security and DDoS defense. All data transmissions are encrypted via SSL/TLS.
legal.privacy_rights_title: 5. Your Rights as a Data Subject
legal.privacy_rights_text: You have the right to access, rectify, restrict, or erase your stored data at any time (Articles 15–21 GDPR). For any privacy inquiries, write to info{'@'}rntm.de. You also hold the right to lodge a complaint with a competent data protection authority.
legal.terms_scope_text: By accessing or using EuroDraft (ed.rntm.de), you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please discontinue using the service.
legal.terms_gameplay_text: EuroDraft is provided for personal, non-commercial entertainment. Automated botting, denial of service attacks, scraping, or exploiting simulation mechanics to impair server infrastructure is strictly prohibited.
legal.terms_ip_text: The source code, custom design systems, and software architecture are protected. Historical player statistics and tournament trivia are referenced under nominative fair use.
legal.terms_liability_text: The game is provided 'as is' without warranties of any kind. We do not assume liability for temporary downtime, data loss, or server interruptions.
legal.contact_desc: Have questions, feedback, or a player position correction? Send us a direct message.

legal.gdpr_portal_subtitle: Automated access requests (Art. 15), JSON data export, and instant server erasure (Art. 17)
legal.gdpr_no_local_data: No local data found in browser storage.
legal.gdpr_export_desc: Exports all locally stored game configurations, squad tactics, and server references as a JSON file.
legal.gdpr_export_success: Your personal data export was downloaded successfully.

legal.gdpr_wipe_local_title: 2. Wipe All Local Browser Data (Art. 17 GDPR)
legal.gdpr_wipe_local_desc: Permanently erases all formations, sound preferences, themes, and game states on this device.
legal.gdpr_wipe_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete all local EuroDraft data and preferences from this device?
legal.gdpr_wipe_success: All local browser storage and game states have been permanently wiped from this device.
legal.gdpr_server_shares_title: 3. Delete Shared Squads from Server (Art. 17 GDPR)
legal.gdpr_server_shares_desc: If you publicly shared a tournament squad, you can permanently remove that record from our server database with one click.
